dischi-08.exo: Prudence, patient work, attention to detail, long-term investments. It points to slow but sure growth, the fruit of attention, craft skill and constancy.
dischi-08.psy: The wisdom of someone who knows how to wait; the patience to cultivate what will grow over time, without forcing the natural rhythms.
dischi-08.ini: Earth in Hod, intellectual Splendour, with the Sun in Virgo in the first decan: sunlight illuminates the fertile, methodical earth. Prudence is intelligence applied to matter, the care that makes things grow slowly.
dischi-08.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals pettiness, avarice, pedantry, excessive slowness.
dischi-08.up: Work with patience and method: growth is slow but sure.
dischi-08.rev: Impatience, a haste that spoils; or excessive caution that blocks.
dischi-08.love: A relationship that grows slowly and solidly, founded on concrete gestures more than on declarations.
dischi-08.spirit: Cultivating the soul as one tends a garden, with daily attention.
dischi-08.crowley: In the Thoth deck a great tree bears eight disks like fruit or flowers, arranged in the geomantic figure Populus: the slow, patient growth of nature.

dischi-09.exo: Gain, material good fortune, wellbeing. It points to inheritances, strokes of luck, concrete results and a financial stability obtained through merit or favourable fate.
dischi-09.psy: The satisfaction of enjoying the fruits of your own work; the inner security that comes from having reached a certain independence.
dischi-09.ini: Earth in Yesod, the Foundation, with Venus in Virgo, her sign of fall, in the second decan: Venusian beauty becomes practical and concrete. Gain is matter finding its stable foundation, the fortune that arises from the union of good luck and good management.
dischi-09.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals greed, ostentation, the loss of what you have gained.
dischi-09.up: Gather the fruits of your work: fortune supports those who have handled their resources with care.
dischi-09.rev: Unstable earnings, losses, dependence on other people's money.
dischi-09.love: Shared wellbeing, a stable relationship, emotional and material security.
dischi-09.work: Earnings, inheritances, financial success, greater economic independence.
dischi-09.spirit: Recognising the grace that manifests even in material wellbeing.
dischi-09.crowley: Crowley arranges nine disks: three at the centre, in a column, surrounded by the other six, almost like planetary coins: fortune gathering around a stable foundation.

dischi-10.exo: Wealth, lasting prosperity, estate, family. It points to material completion, the stability that is passed on through time, inheritances and shared goods.
dischi-10.psy: The satisfaction of someone who has built something solid and lasting; but also the risk that wealth becomes an end in itself, losing its purpose.
dischi-10.ini: Earth in Malkuth, with Mercury in Virgo, his house and exaltation, in the third decan: Mercurial intelligence organises matter in its most complete form. Wealth is the completion of the material Work, which must however return to circulation so as not to stagnate.
dischi-10.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals avarice, heaviness, materialism, stagnation of goods.
dischi-10.up: Prosperity and stability: the fruit of long labour is ripe, so share it.
dischi-10.rev: Wealth that stagnates or is scattered; conflicts over inheritances or family property.
dischi-10.love: A solid family, a lasting relationship, long-term plans.
dischi-10.work: Full success, estate, family businesses, stability.
dischi-10.spirit: Wealth as responsibility: keeping the gifts received in circulation.
dischi-10.crowley: In the Thoth deck ten disks arranged on the Tree of Life carry the symbols of Mercury, with the largest disk in Malkuth: wealth which, to stay alive, must circulate.

dischi-cavaliere.exo: A practical, hard-working and reliable person, tied to the land and to tangible results; or a long piece of work that reaches its harvest. It points to effort well spent, constancy and prudence.
dischi-cavaliere.psy: Energy put at the service of concreteness: the ability to work stubbornly to nourish yourself and others, at the cost of seeming slow or dull.
dischi-cavaliere.ini: Fire of Earth, the Yod of the final He, referred to Chokmah: the warmth that makes things germinate, the force of mountains and earthquakes. He rules from 21° Leo to 20° Virgo, where solar vigour places itself at the service of the reaping.
dischi-cavaliere.sha: Ill-dignified, he is miserly, dull, jealous of what is his, shut in a labour without horizon.
dischi-cavaliere.up: Persevere with patience: steady work leads to a concrete and secure harvest.
dischi-cavaliere.rev: Slowness that becomes inertia, stubbornness, materialism; or effort that reaps nothing for lack of vision.
dischi-cavaliere.love: A faithful and concrete partner, not very romantic but present and protective.
dischi-cavaliere.work: Agricultural, craft or managerial work; long projects that demand tenacity.
dischi-cavaliere.spirit: Working the earth as prayer: the cycle of sowing and harvest as a path.
dischi-cavaliere.crowley: The Knight of the Thoth deck rides a heavy draught horse, helmet lowered and a flail in hand, in a field of ripe wheat: strength in the service of the reaping.

dischi-regina.exo: A generous, practical, affectionate person able to make fertile whatever she touches; or a phase of quiet prosperity. It points to care of the home, the body and resources.
dischi-regina.psy: The ability to nourish concretely: affection that expresses itself in doing and providing. It asks you not to forget your own needs while you look after those of others.
dischi-regina.ini: Water of Earth, the He of the final He, referred to Binah: the moisture that makes the soil fertile. She rules from 21° Sagittarius to 20° Capricorn, joining Sagittarian drive to Capricornian tenacity, like the desert that blooms after the rains.
dischi-regina.sha: Ill-dignified, she is apathetic, servile, dependent, able to lose herself in routine or materialism.
dischi-regina.up: Cultivate what you love with patience: your concrete care transforms and makes things flower.
dischi-regina.rev: Exhaustion from caring for others, neglect of yourself; or excessive attachment to comfort.
dischi-regina.love: A warm and protective partner; a relationship that creates home, stability and wellbeing.
dischi-regina.work: Careful management of resources, caring work, agriculture, household or business economics.
dischi-regina.spirit: Recognising the sacred in the fertility and generosity of nature.
dischi-regina.crowley: The Queen of Disks in the Thoth deck sits between an arid expanse and a river that makes it fertile, with a goat on a rock beside her and a globe of interlaced circles: matter allowing itself to be fertilised.

dischi-principe.exo: An energetic, capable and reliable person who finishes what he starts; or a concrete project advancing steadily. It points to management, gradual growth, practical sense.
dischi-principe.psy: Intelligence applied to matter: the ability to plan and to realise, with a calm but inexorable temperament, which can become slowness or dullness.
dischi-principe.ini: Air of Earth, the Vau of the final He, referred to Tiphareth: thought that organises matter, the cultivated fields and the routes of communication. He rules from 21° Aries to 20° Taurus, where Martial impulse turns into patient Venusian building.
dischi-principe.sha: Ill-dignified, he is slow, dull, lazy, greedy, jealous of his possessions.
dischi-principe.up: Carry your projects forward with method and constancy: your reliability is the key to success.
dischi-principe.rev: Slowness that becomes stasis, stubbornness, loss of motivation.
dischi-principe.love: A reliable and concrete partner, not very expansive but constant.
dischi-principe.work: Management, construction, solid entrepreneurial activity, methodical work.
dischi-principe.spirit: The Work that is accomplished step by step, like a field ploughed with patience.
dischi-principe.crowley: The Prince of Disks in the Thoth deck drives a chariot drawn by an ox through a fertile landscape, holding a globe and a sceptre: the energy that makes the earth fertile.

dischi-principessa.astro: Celestial quadrant of Aries, Taurus, Gemini; throne of the Ace
dischi-principessa.exo: A gentle, generous and concrete young person, or a phase of gestation: something precious is growing in silence. It points to studies, new occupations, pregnancies in the literal or figurative sense.
dischi-principessa.psy: The potential preparing to be born; the patience to guard and nourish what is not yet visible, rooted in the body and the senses.
dischi-principessa.ini: Earth of Earth, the final He of the final He, referred to Malkuth: the densest point of manifestation, where the light is most hidden and, for that very reason, closest to being reborn. Throne of the Ace of Disks, she rules the celestial quadrant of Aries, Taurus and Gemini.
dischi-principessa.sha: Ill-dignified, she is scattered, prodigal, lazy, a slave to the senses.
dischi-principessa.up: Guard and nourish what is growing: the promise will be fulfilled in its own time.
dischi-principessa.rev: Gestation interrupted or postponed, laziness, waste.
dischi-principessa.love: A relationship preparing for a concrete step; a possible wish for family.
dischi-principessa.work: Studies, apprenticeship, a new job, projects that are ripening.
dischi-principessa.spirit: The Daughter who will be raised to the Mother's throne: matter becoming light.
dischi-principessa.crowley: The Princess of Disks in the Thoth deck is pregnant, crowned with ram's horns, with a sceptre sinking into the earth and a rose-disk: the earth heavy with hidden light.
